metadata.summary: A large chest x-ray image dataset with multi-label annotated radiographic reports, including >160,000 images from 67,000 patients interpreted at Hospital Universitario de San Juan (Spain) between 2009 and 2017; covers six position views and includes demographic and acquisition metadata.

papers.title: PadChest — A large chest x-ray image dataset with multi-label annotated reports

ethics.privacy_measures: De-identification applied (explicitly stated in full paper: 'all images and reports were de-identified prior to release').

extraction.notes: Baseline card derived solely from dataset_catalog.xlsx real metadata; remaining fields require paper/README or manual completion.
pending_verification: geography.countries is heuristically inferred from limitation text; requires manual verification

known_limitations: Single-center origin limits geographic and demographic diversity.
No reported age, sex, or ethnicity distribution hinders bias assessment.
27% manual annotation vs. 73% semi-automated labeling introduces potential systematic label noise.
Reports are in Spanish only, limiting linguistic generalizability.
bias_and_limitations.representativeness_concerns: Single-center Spanish hospital data; no evidence of balanced representation across age, sex, or ethnicity.
bias_and_limitations.long_tail_classes: Hierarchical taxonomy includes 174 findings, 19 diagnoses, and 104 locations — high cardinality suggests potential long-tail class distribution, though not quantified in source.
bias_and_limitations.subgroup_coverage: No subgroup coverage analysis reported (e.g., by age group, sex, or comorbidity).

data_origin.selection_rationale: Images and reports were obtained from routine clinical chest x-ray examinations performed at Hospital Universitario de San Juan.
data_origin.sampling_strategy: Consecutive clinical exams from 2009 to 2017; no explicit description of sampling strategy beyond temporal coverage and institutional source.
data_origin.data_shifts_overtime: Data collected from 2009 to 2017; no explicit description of known longitudinal shifts in equipment, protocols, or population distribution.

population.target_population: Patients undergoing chest x-ray examinations at Hospital Universitario de San Juan, Spain.
population.missing_groups: No explicit reporting of age, sex, or ethnicity distributions; demographic data is present but not summarized in source text.

attribute_recording.unknown_proportion: Demographic attributes (e.g., age, sex) are included in the dataset but not described in the abstract regarding recording method or proportion of missing/unknown values.

annotation.annotation_method: 27% manually annotated by trained physicians; remaining labeled using a supervised recurrent neural network with attention mechanisms, validated on independent test set achieving 0.93 Micro-F1.
annotation.labeling_provenance: Radiology reports in Spanish, labeled with hierarchical taxonomy of findings, diagnoses, and anatomic locations mapped to UMLS.
annotation.label_noise_description: Automatically generated labels (73%) were validated on an independent test set (Micro-F1 = 0.93), implying residual label noise.
